coinvariants.actual_lattice_inputs: H3 of a smooth cubic threefold is a rank10 unimodular symplectic lattice; D has characteristic polynomial Phi11; P is symplectic and P D P^-1=D^9. Parent establishes the rational character.
coinvariants.pairing_proof: b(x,y)=B(x,(D-1)^(-1)y) mod Z is a perfect symmetric pairing on L/(D-1)L=Z11. P^-1 D P=D^5 implies b(Px,Py)=9 b(x,y). The scalar alpha obeys alpha^2=9 and alpha^5=1, hence alpha=3.
coinvariants.negative_control: The natural semilinear action on Z[zeta11] has the same rational character but acts as1 on its Z11 coinvariant. It does not preserve the unimodular symplectic form; rational character data alone would leave an erroneous order11 sector.

tangent.stable_real_tangent: TM plus R^3 is the real bundle associated to rho:C11:C5 -> SU5.
tangent.exact_sequence: On the punctured invariant hypersurface, T(cone) plus C = C^5_rho equivariantly, because df has trivial target; radial restriction gives the stated stable real tangent bundle downstairs.
tangent.transfer_argument: Both Sylow restrictions of c2(rho) vanish. Transfer then annihilates c2 by both5 and11, hence c2=0 integrally on BG.
tangent.lambda_reason: For an SU bundle lambda(real rho)=-c2(rho). Stable pullback therefore gives lambda(TM)=0, including all torsion.
tangent.string_structure_unique: H3(M,Z)=0, so the set of lifts has one homotopy class.
tangent.quantization_scope: No internal gravitational half-shift in the usual [G4/(2pi)]-lambda/2 integral law. A flat torsion class is not de Rham G4 flux. This does not compute the electric M2 Page charge or one-loop terms.
